fact: At INTERPOL's meetings in Abidjan on 1-3 April 2025, two months before the close of SIPAO's European Union-funded 3EDF component, Benin's delegation (the SIPAO focal point, the director of the DACORE and an AFIS expert) took part in a workshop on moving to autonomous national management of the SIPAO systems, and the meetings recommended that each country integrate SIPAO into its police and judicial investigation architecture and provide the infrastructure, staff and financing to sustain it.
title: ATELIER ET RÉUNION STRATÉGIQUES SUR LE PROGRAMME SIPAO
publisher: Ministère de la Justice et de la Législation
